priorStatuses.title: Handle missing cache entries before trimming

findings.title: [P1] Restrict login redirects to trusted destinations
findings.body: When `returnUrl` is influenced by the login request, passing it directly to `location.assign` permits navigation to an attacker-controlled external or executable URL. Validate it as an allowed same-origin path or map it to a trusted destination.

findings.title: [P1] Stop logging issued tokens in plaintext
findings.body: Every issued authentication token is passed through `audit` to `console.log`. Environments that retain or expose stdout therefore disclose replayable credentials to log consumers.

findings.title: [P1] Stop logging issued tokens in plaintext
findings.body:
Every call with a live authentication token writes that credential to stdout. In environments where console output is retained or accessible to operators/log consumers, the token can be replayed to impersonate its owner.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P1] Redact issued tokens before auditing
findings.body:
Every live token passed to `recordIssuedToken` is written verbatim via `console.log`. In environments that collect or expose stdout logs, anyone with log access can recover the credential and impersonate its holder until it expires.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
